facts.frame: LongTeng LTK266-D--SL super-light integrated carbon road frameset with UDH
facts.frame_material: Exact-model secondary profile reports Toray T1100 carbon; the accessible manufacturer page does not expose the grade in text
facts.frame_construction: Fully internal lightweight road frame with replaceable UDH and 12×100 / 12×142 mm thru axles
facts.stiffness_evidence: No accepted measured exact-model stiffness result; the secondary profile characterizes it as a minimalist non-aero lightweight road frame
facts.frame_weight_basis: Exact-model secondary profile reports approximately 760 g frame and 325 g fork; size, paint and included-hardware basis are not stated
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Published maximum in the exact-model secondary profile. Reported 40.7–43 mm actual owner fits were described as tight or eventually insufficient and are not promoted as clearance

source_note: The manufacturer establishes the exact current frame identity. The accepted detailed specification is secondary: it reports 760 g, T47, UDH and a 35 mm published maximum. Wider owner fits around 41–43 mm are retained only as cautionary context because they were tight, not as a verified safe maximum.
